## Professional Summary

Data Scientist, Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning (MEL) specialist with over ten years building the data systems that health and development programmes use.

At [Family Planning Association of Malawi](https://www.fpamalawi.org/) (an IPPF Member Association) I lead the monitoring, evaluation and data function across **over 20 service delivery points** and a team of **at least 15** people . I own an indicator architecture of **over 20 disaggregated KPIs**, wrote the R and ETL pipelines that consolidates data from DHIS2, KoboToolbox and OpenEMR into one governed reporting dataset (**45% faster processing**), and built the Power BI and R Shiny dashboards that management and field teams use for routine decision making. The data quality assessment cycles I lead raised indicator reporting consistency by **25%** and data accuracy by **30%**, and my analysis supported reporting to US Depaertment of State (formerly USAID), Global Fund, FCDO, UNFPA, KfW, IPPF and Global Affairs Canada.

Before FPAM, at ADRA Malawi, I designed baseline and endline household surveys including study protocols, instrument development, data collection, and analysis. Additionally I moved five districts from paper to digital data collection, reducing delays and  reporting errors by a combined **40%**.

I hold an [MSc in Data Science for Health and Social Care](https://mgphs.ed.ac.uk/msc-data-science-for-health-and-social-care) **with Merit** from the [University of Edinburgh](https://www.ed.ac.uk/). My [dissertation](dissertation.qmd) evaluated the reach and engagement of a digital health diabetes platform used by around 15,500 people in NHS England.

## What I Do

- **MEL systems & evaluation:** logframes, indicator reference sheets, data quality assessments, baseline/endline survey design, donor reporting.
- **Health information systems:** DHIS2 administration and API extraction, OpenEMR/CMIS, KoboToolbox/ODK, and training staff on data use (over 50 trained).
- **Data engineering & BI:** ETL pipelines in R, SQL and Python; Power BI semantic models, DAX, Power Query and row-level security; R Shiny.
- **Statistical modelling & machine learning:** regression, survival analysis (Cox models), random forests, tidymodels, reproducible research with Quarto and versioning with Git.

## Experience

**Monitoring, Evaluation and Data Lead** | Family Planning Association of Malawi | Jan 2021 – present

- Lead MEL and data across 20+ service delivery points; own  over 30 KPI indicator architecture and 10+ SOPs on data validation, governance and security.
- Built R/ETL pipelines consolidating DHIS2, KoboToolbox and OpenEMR, cutting processing time by 45% and feeding Power BI and Shiny dashboards.
- Improved reporting consistency by 25% and data accuracy by 30% through structured data quality assessment and verification cycles.

**Data Management Officer** | ADRA Malawi | Oct 2016 – Dec 2020

- Designed and analysed baseline and endline surveys for climate-smart agriculture, nutrition and health programmes.
- Rolled out ODK/KoboToolbox across five districts, cutting paper-based errors by 40% and data entry lag from 14 days to under 48 hours.
- Built donor dashboards for WFP (BMZ), EU and USAID portfolios, with 100% on-time reporting across a four-year cycle.
